scope: Official runtime documentation only; not source-code reproduction or method evaluation

sources.name: Docker Agent Budget
reviewed_sections: A name is one shared pot
Limits are checked at turn boundaries
max_tokens here is not the model's max_tokens
findings: Compaction calls use the run-wide and named budgets, including dedicated compaction models.
Limits are checked between turns and may overshoot by an in-flight turn.
Cumulative token usage is distinguished from context length and per-response output caps.

sources.name: Yielded Agent Context management
findings: Retained history, working prompt, and application-owned memory are distinguished.
Compaction preserves protected instructions and complete tool pairs; summary work consumes the Run budget.
Retained excerpts and notes are reference material, not trusted instructions.

interpretation: Shared budget accounting and retained-history/prompt separation are ordinary infrastructure, not the proposed novel contribution. Documentation-level overlap does not prove all implementation details or future extensions equivalent.
